title: Meeting notes
audience: For anyone who leaves meetings with messy notes and a vague sense of who does what.
description: Paste rough notes or a transcript after a meeting. Your AI writes the summary, the decisions and who does what.
tagline: What was decided, and who does what.
seoTitle: Meeting notes to action items template for AI
note:
Meeting notes

After a meeting, paste your rough notes or the transcript into your AI. The summary and action items land here, newest meeting first.

## Action items
Who does what, and by when. Ticked when done.

## Meetings
One section per meeting: what was said in two lines, and what was decided.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Meeting notes". After a meeting I'll paste my rough notes or a transcript. Read the note with fetch, then add a section at the start of "Meetings" with edit: a "###" heading with the meeting name and date, a two-line summary, and the decisions as bullets. Add each action item under "Action items" as a checklist line like "- [ ] Owner: task (due date)". If something is unclear, ask me before writing it. When I say an item is done, tick it ("- [x]").

asks: Ask me for my meeting notes or transcript, then add the summary and action items.
Mark Jonas's design review as done.

After a meeting, paste your rough notes or the transcript into your AI. The summary and action items land here, newest meeting first.

## Action items
Who does what, and by when. Ticked when done.
- [ ] Sara: send the new pricing to sales (10 Nov)
- [ ] Emma: check Norway's VAT rules (next week)
- [x] Jonas: review the checkout design (6 Nov)

## Meetings
One section per meeting: what was said in two lines, and what was decided.
### Pricing sync, 5 November
Three plans stay, the lifetime deal goes, and the yearly discount drops to 15%.

- Decided: no lifetime plan.
- Open: whether students get the Pro plan free.

### Design review, 3 November
The new checkout is approved with two changes: the total shows before the card details, and the error messages are in plain words.
